title: Global sections of a residue lift evaluate sections
statement: Let W be a scheme, w a point of W, U an open containing w, and a a section of O_W on U. For the residue lift p_U of [def-sc-picard-derived-model-sections] to U and the residue field of [def-weil-residue-field], ΓSpecIso κ(w) applied to p_U.appTop(U.topIso.inv a) equals W.evaluation U w hwU a.

proof.text: Factor the residue lift as Spec of the residue quotient followed by the stalk lift to V, using cancellation of V.ι. Composing with V.toSpecΓ identifies the ring map with germ followed by residue. Naturality of ΓSpecIso and cancellation of its inverse give evaluation.

lean.statement:
theorem picardResidueLift_appTop_eval (W : Scheme.{v}) (w : W)
    (U : W.Opens) (hwU : w ∈ U) (a : Γ(W, U)) :
    (ΓSpecIso (W.residueField w)).hom
      ((picardResidueLift W w U hwU).appTop (U.topIso.inv a)) =
        W.evaluation U w hwU a
